text: {"assertions":["A spurious 429 rate limiting error was discovered in api/gateway/rate_limit.go affecting only clients still using the v1 SDK.","The root cause of the spurious 429 errors was a listener that was registered but never removed during teardown, causing throttle counters to exceed the configured ceiling.","The fix was implemented in PR #7239 on branch fix/spurious-429-1, which removes the listener on teardown and includes a test assertion to prevent regression.","The spurious 429 issue can be reproduced using a saved burst fixture.","The rate limiter is implemented in Go with its tests located in api/gateway/rate_limit_test.go.","The backlog cleared within 6 minutes following the deployment of the fix."]}
